01We are an authorised dealer for the long-established companies ENVI-PUR s.r.o.

We are an authorised dealer for the long-established companies ENVI-PUR s.r.o. and ASIO spol. s.r.o., the largest manufacturers of technologies for wastewater treatment and water treatment in the Czech Republic.

Both manufacturers offer a huge range of products, which allows us to meet almost any customer need in the field of water management.

We work only with companies whose products are based on simple but effective principles. Our service technicians have many years of very good experience with both ENVI-PUR and ASIO products.

02Our wastewater treatment services

Our wastewater treatment services:

  • Consultation and advice
  • Preparation of design documentation
  • Obtaining the relevant building permit
  • Sale of technologies
  • Assembly and installation of the technology
  • Servicing and maintenance
  • Sale of spare parts

Domestic wastewater treatment plants from ENVI-PUR and ASIO are suitable for family homes and holiday homes, cabins and cottages. These technologies can treat all household wastewater (water from the kitchen, bathroom, toilet, washing machine, dishwasher, etc.).

The treatment plants comply with the standards and regulations in force in the Czech Republic and the European Union. They are certified to ČSN EN12566-3+A2. Treated wastewater from these plants can be discharged not only into surface water (a stream, river, pond or combined sewer) but also into groundwater (infiltration, spray irrigation). The specific method of discharging the treated wastewater is always chosen while the design documentation is being prepared.
